title: Session 1: Introduction

Why Use R?
R is free and open-source, has a large ecosystem of packages, and is widely used in academia and industry for data analysis and visualization.

title: Introduction to R
text:
Course Overview
This ad-hoc course introduces students to basic R programming for data analysis. Students will learn how to manipulate data, perform statistical and econometric analysis, and visualize data using R.
